question:
Choose the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.

The trend of artwork among Middle Eastern ladies is nothing new, yet nail paint is frequently __overlooked__.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"overlooked"** means to fail to notice or consider something; to disregard or ignore. (अनदेखा करना)

 
 
• **Example: **She **overlooked **the small details in the contract, leading to future complications.
 
 
 
• **"Neglected" **refers to something that has been given little attention or care; ignored. (उपेक्षित)
 
 
• **Example: **The garden was **neglected** for years and was overgrown with weeds.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'overlooked' **is **'neglected'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Appreciated **(सराहा हुआ): Recognized the value or significance of something.

 
 
• **Example:** Her efforts were greatly **appreciated **by her colleagues.
 
 
 
• **Pranked **(मज़ाक किया हुआ): Played a trick or practical joke on someone.
 
 
• **Example: **They **pranked** their friend by hiding his car keys.
 
 
 
• **Sedated** (शांत किया हुआ): Calmed or induced sleep through the use of sedatives.
 
 
• **Example:** The patient was** sedated** before the surgery.
